Pages as Tide's reader returns them (Readability over the page's HTML, text only), recorded once so
the source-led lesson tests never touch the network. Each file names its address and the day it was
read. The text belongs to its authors: Python documentation (PSF License), MDN (CC BY-SA 2.5),
PostgreSQL documentation (PostgreSQL Licence), Mixpanel documentation, Wikipedia (CC BY-SA 4.0).
blog-raft.json, wall.json and the book passages in the test file are written for the tests.
